title: MCP Baarakɛlaw
findMore: Aw ye MCP baarakɛminɛn wɛrɛw sɔrɔ yɔrɔ la
allowPermissions: A to MCP Baarakɛminɛnw ka yamaruya bɛɛ
allowPermissionsDesc: Ni a dabɔra, MCP baarakɛminɛn weleli bɛɛ bɛna sɔn a yɛrɛma k’a sɔrɔ u ma yamaruya dialoguew jira. Nin sigicogo in bɛ tali kɛ diɲɛ fan bɛɛ la baro bɛɛ la, hali baro kura.

runtimeSettings.title: Baarakɛwaati labɛncogo
runtimeSettings.description: Novera bɛ MCP baarakɛminɛnw ɲɛnabɔ ani k’u lajɛ kokura cogo min na, o labɛn.
runtimeSettings.toolCallTimeoutDesc: Waati camanba min bɛ kɛ ka MCP baarakɛminɛn jaabi makɔnɔ sani waati ka ban.
runtimeSettings.maxToolOutputCharsDesc: Baarakɛminɛn janyalenba jaabi min maralen bɛ baro kɔnɔ. Fɛn o fɛn tɛmɛna nin kan, o bɛ tigɛtigɛ ka taamasiyɛn kɛ ko a tigɛlen don, o la, nɔba kelen tɛ se ka modɛli in kɔnɔkow sɛgɛn. Aw bɛ a bila 0 la walasa jaabiw ka to u bɛɛ la.
runtimeSettings.smartToolRoutingDesc: Ni a dabɔra, Novera bɛ MCP baarakɛminɛnw sugandi minnu bɛ tali kɛ u la ka sɔrɔ ka baarakɛminɛnw doni. A bali ka MCP baarakɛminɛnw lisɛli dafalen doni tuma bɛɛ.
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModel: Baara kɛ ni modɛli kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen ye sirako la
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModelDesc: Ni smart routing bɛ sen na, i ka routing step kɛ ni modeli danfaralen ye (a ka c’a la a ka dɔgɔn) chat model nɔ na. Aw bɛ a faga walasa ka baara kɛ ni chat model active ye tuma bɛɛ routing kama.
runtimeSettings.routerModelDesc: Aw bɛ furakɛlikɛla ni modɛli sugandi yɔrɔ kelen na. Modeli nɔgɔmanw dɔrɔn de bɛ jate walasa siraw ka to teliya la ani u sɔngɔ ka dɔgɔ.
runtimeSettings.routerModelEmptyList: Modeli nɔgɔmanw tɛ sɔrɔ. Modèle fitinin dɔ fara a kan walima ka API keys labɛn Models kɔnɔ.
